title: Hold To Attack
description: Simple. Hold to Attack. Nothing complicated. Precise.
body:
# ⚔️ HoldToAttack
**HoldToAttack** is a simple, lightweight client-side Quality of Life mod that perfects your combat experience. No more spam-clicking or mistiming your hits! 
With this mod, you can simply **hold down your attack button** (left-click by default), and the game will automatically strike at the exact moment your weapon's attack cooldown is fully reset (100% strength). 
### ✨ Features
* **Perfect Timing:** Always deals maximum damage by waiting for the attack cooldown indicator to fill up before swinging.
* **Save Your Mouse (and Fingers):** Say goodbye to carpal tunnel and broken mice from intense PvP or mob farming.
* **Fully Client-Side:** Works on **any** multiplayer server or realm without needing to be installed on the server! 
* **Smart Targeting:** The mod intelligently checks if you are actually looking at a valid target before swinging, preventing random air attacks.
* **Seamless Vanilla Feel:** Doesn't add any new items, blocks, or messy GUIs—just improves the vanilla combat mechanics.
### ❓ FAQ
**Can I use this on a multiplayer server?**
Yes! Since this is a 100% client-side mod, it works perfectly on any server, regardless of whether the server has the mod installed or not. *(Note: Always check the rules of competitive servers like Hypixel to ensure auto-attackers/macros are allowed!)*

**Which mod loader does this require?**
Currently, Fabric and Neoforge.

**Will there be others?** You are free to contribute.
